purpose: Immutable baseline for the failure investigation. Every diagnostic in reports/GANJAVE_FAILURE_INVESTIGATION.md is compared against this. This file must never be edited.

decision.scope_of_a_pass: A pass would establish only that this implementation reproduces these observations under these conditions. It is not a validation of any composed process, and not a claim of general predictive accuracy.
what_this_never_establishes: validation of a composed process: no composition was evaluated
general predictive accuracy beyond paper Fig. 3's and Fig. 5's conditions

E_heldout_trajectory.statement: The implementation predicts the paper's held-out experimental biomass trajectory to within 1.5 g/L DCW RMS.

F_no_worse_than_authors_model.statement: The implementation's trajectory error is not materially worse than the authors' own plotted model curve over the same observations.

G_oxygen_limiting_regime.statement: The culture becomes oxygen-limited after feeding starts.

H_agreement_with_reported_uncertainty.statement: A clear majority of observations are reproduced within twice the digitisation's own uncertainty.

J_determinism.statement: Two runs of the same configuration agree.
